title: Remove WebView light mode
summary: Removed the operator-facing Light theme control from the WebView shell and clamped runtime theme handling to dark mode.
reason: Light mode should no longer be selectable or restored from stale local UI preferences.
behavior_before: The top bar exposed a Light button, keyboard shortcuts could invoke the theme toggle, and stored mediapipeline-theme=light preferences could reapply body.light-mode.
behavior_after: The top bar no longer exposes a Light button, the theme shortcut is gone, stale theme-toggle DOM is removed defensively, and runtime theme application always removes body.light-mode and stores dark.
